# Pull request guide

Choose a template based on the files in your pull request.

- For changes limited to `docs/`, use the [docs template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/docs.md) with `template=docs.md`.
- For any changes in `website/` or `uniapi/`, use the [code template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/code.md) with `template=code.md`. This also covers pull requests that include documentation changes.

To load the template, add its `template` parameter to the GitHub compare URL for your branches. Use `?` to start the query string or `&` if the URL already has query parameters. You can also copy the template Markdown into the pull request description. [GitHub's pull request URL options](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/reference/using-query-parameters-to-create-a-pull-request)

See the [README](../README.md#contributing) for SOP review and development instructions.
